what: Grid cards fly in from an offset position and settle into place as each row enters the screen — by default odd rows start 100·100·70·70px below and ±30·±20px to the side, even rows the reverse, .5s circ.out staggered by .07s. is-dot-active is added .37s after settling. With look: side, the two end cards wait tilted 150px to the side and 10° at half opacity, then stand up straight at .67s

options.sp: Column count on phone (767px or less), default 2
options.look: with side, the type that tilts in from both sides

from.where: index.html .msgs__list (message cards) · .adm__list (admission cards, look: side) — original bg (panel build) · admissions panel CSS
